settings.visualStyle: Immersive first-person WWII historical reenactment, Bastogne December 1944, U.S. 101st Airborne composite soldier POV, snow, fog, pine woods, frozen foxholes, damaged Belgian town streets, period winter uniforms and equipment, non-graphic combat, no modern objects, no game HUD. Prioritize cold, numb hands, wet snow, fog, silence, distant engines and exhausted waiting rather than constant action.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 scenes x 8 seconds = 120 seconds. Fictional composite U.S. airborne infantry soldier POV during the defense of Bastogne in the Battle of the Bulge. One action and one camera movement per scene. No spoken dialogue, no narration and no intelligible human speech. Do not make every scene a firefight. Use long quiet beats in foxholes, fog, night watch, supply handling and weather changes. Let battlefield intensity rise and fall naturally. Audio uses breathing, nonverbal exertion, winter wind, snow, footsteps, engines, aircraft, equipment and distant battlefield effects only.
settings.customVisualStyle: Photorealistic first-person winter warfare reenactment, muted snow colors, fog, visible cold breath, wet wool, frozen soil, pine forests, practical 1944 U.S. airborne gear, restrained handheld camera. Camera behaves like a cold tired human body with stiff movement, pauses and small balance corrections. Preserve mud, frost, snow and fatigue continuity.

movie.storyTitle: WWII Soldier POV EP04 — Bastogne: Surrounded in the Snow
movie.storySummary: A fictional U.S. airborne infantry soldier arrives near Bastogne in December 1944, digs into frozen positions, endures encirclement and shortages, watches the weather finally clear, and ends as a relief corridor opens while the fighting continues.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Put the viewer in the eyes of a fictional composite U.S. airborne infantry soldier during the defense of Bastogne in December 1944. Make the viewer feel frozen ground through gloves, wet snow on sleeves, stiff fingers, fog hiding the tree line, hunger, fatigue, long night watches and the physical relief of changing weather and supplies. Do not use gunfire or explosions in every scene. Several scenes should be almost silent except for breath, wind, snow, branches and equipment. Tell everything visually with no spoken dialogue and no narrator.

scenes.title: Road to Bastogne
scenes.description: POV rides in a truck column toward Bastogne through winter roads.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier grips the cold truck side as the convoy moves through snow, glove sliding slightly on wet painted metal.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person U.S. airborne soldier in open truck, winter road, snow-covered fields, period convoy ahead, wet glove on cold steel rail, gray sky, slush on vehicle floor.
scenes.videoPrompt: Handheld POV sways with moving truck. Audio foreground: breath, web gear and wet glove on metal. Mid-ground: engine, tires through slush. Background: winter wind and very distant artillery. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Town Square
scenes.description: The convoy passes through crowded Bastogne streets.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV looks from the truck toward soldiers and vehicles moving through town while snowmelt drips from roofs.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person winter Bastogne street, U.S. military vehicles, soldiers moving, stone buildings, slush, roof drips, exhaust haze, civilians only in distant safe areas, no graphic damage.
scenes.videoPrompt: One slow pan from convoy ahead to crowded town edge. Audio: engines, boots in slush, roof drips, wind and breathing; distant artillery remains background only. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Frozen Ground
scenes.description: The soldier begins digging a defensive position outside town.
scenes.actionDescription: Hands strike frozen soil with an entrenching tool; each impact jars the wrists and barely chips the ground.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person hands digging frozen earth beside snow-covered pine woods, airborne sleeves, ice crystals on soil, scratched entrenching tool and compacted snow around boots.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low static POV with repeated digging motion. Audio: sharp metal-on-frozen-ground impacts, breath, fabric, occasional branch movement, distant guns. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Fog on the Line
scenes.description: A deliberate quiet observation scene; heavy fog hides the fields beyond the foxhole.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV slowly peers over the snowy foxhole and remains still, watching fog move between dark pines without firing.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view over snow-rimmed foxhole toward a foggy Belgian field and dark tree line, rifle resting unused on edge, frost on wood and metal, tiny snowflakes collecting on glove.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow lean upward, then hold almost completely still. No gunfire nearby, no explosion and no music. Audio foreground: slow breath and slight glove movement. Mid-ground: soft wind, pine branches, loose snow falling. Background: faint engine rumble that may disappear into fog. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Armour in the Mist
scenes.description: Tank silhouettes appear briefly beyond the tree line.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier raises binoculars toward dark armored silhouettes, hands trembling slightly from cold and tension.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person binocular view through winter fog toward distant German armored silhouettes near tree line, frost on glove edge, no firing shown.
scenes.videoPrompt: One binocular raise and hold. Audio: distant engines, winter wind, binocular handling, faster breathing. No firing by POV. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Artillery Snow
scenes.description: A distant artillery burst throws snow from nearby trees.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV drops deeper into the foxhole as snow shakes from branches and lands on helmet and sleeves.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person foxhole, clumps of snow falling from pine branches after a distant shell burst, wet crystals on sleeves and rifle, squadmate crouched nearby, non-graphic.
scenes.videoPrompt: Camera drops once into foxhole. Audio: one artillery thump, branches shaking, snow hitting helmet and fabric, heavy breathing. Do not add continuous shelling. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Low Ammunition
scenes.description: The squad quietly checks remaining ammunition and supplies.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV opens a small ammunition container, counts the limited clips and touches a frozen ration wrapper.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view of few ammunition clips and rations inside snowy foxhole, cracked winter gloves, frost on container edges, damp cloth and muddy snow visible.
scenes.videoPrompt: Static close POV with one box-opening and count action. Audio: latch click, cartridges, paper wrapper, wind and breathing. Background battle sound low and intermittent. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Night Watch
scenes.description: A long quiet night-watch scene where almost nothing happens.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV rubs numb gloved fingers, raises the rifle toward the dark field, then simply waits while breath forms clouds.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person winter night foxhole, faint moonlight on uneven snow, rifle pointed toward empty dark field, visible cold breath, frost on glove seams, black pine silhouettes and no active combat in frame.
scenes.videoPrompt: Very slow lift from hands to dark field, then hold. No gunfire nearby, no explosion, no music. Audio: cold wind, breath, fabric rubbing, tiny ice crystals shifting, one distant tree creak. Battlefield noise should be almost absent. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Bastogne Morning
scenes.description: A gray morning reveals battered roads and continuous traffic inside town.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier walks one block through town carrying supplies, boots dragging through slush at a tired pace.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person walk through cold Bastogne street carrying supply box, period jeeps and troops, damaged stone buildings, dirty snow, exhaust, slush and no bodies.
scenes.videoPrompt: Steady forward walk through one street. Audio: boots through slush, engine idle, box rattle, roof drip and breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: The Sky Clears
scenes.description: A quiet sensory scene as clouds finally break and sunlight reaches the snow.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV tilts upward from the foxhole to the clearing sky and pauses while sunlight catches ice crystals on nearby branches.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view from snowy foxhole toward clearing winter sky over Belgian woods, sunlight breaking through fog, ice crystals sparkling on pine branches, damp glove and rifle edge in foreground.
scenes.videoPrompt: One slow upward tilt to blue opening in clouds, then hold. No nearby combat and no music. Audio: wind softening, melting snow drip, distant aircraft gradually becoming audible, calm breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Resupply
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier watches one supply parachute descend beyond the tree line and tracks it slowly.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person snowy field view with multiple supply parachutes descending in distance under clear winter sky, period aircraft far above, sunlight on snow surface.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow pan following one descending parachute. Audio: aircraft engines, wind, parachute fabric at distance, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Fresh Ammunition
scenes.description: The unit receives new ammunition and food.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV hands one ammunition box to the next foxhole, fingers stiff around the handle.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person gloves passing ammunition box along snowy defensive line, snow stuck to boots, squadmates in damp winter gear, box edges scuffed and frosted.
scenes.videoPrompt: One handoff motion from POV to adjacent soldier. Audio: box movement, cartridge rattle, snow crunch, wind and breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Engines from the South
scenes.description: Distant friendly armored engines are heard approaching.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV turns toward a snowy road as distant U.S. vehicles slowly emerge through haze.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view down snowy Belgian road toward distant U.S. armored silhouettes moving through haze, soldiers watching from roadside, churned snow and muddy tire tracks.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow pan toward approaching vehicles. Audio: engine rumble growing gradually, wind, boots in snow, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: The Corridor Opens
scenes.description: Relief forces reach the Bastogne area and traffic begins moving through a corridor.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV watches vehicles enter town while keeping the rifle shouldered, body still tense despite the relief.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person Bastogne road with U.S. vehicles moving into town, dirty snow, damaged stone buildings, exhaust haze and soldier's rifle in foreground.
scenes.videoPrompt: Static roadside POV as vehicles pass. Audio: engines, tire chains, boots, wind and breathing. No cheering, no dialogue, no narration.

scenes.title: Back to the Line
scenes.description: The soldier returns toward the snowy perimeter as the wider battle continues.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV walks back toward foxholes with resupplied gear at a slow fatigued pace.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person walk into snow-covered pine defensive line at late afternoon, ammunition and rifle visible, boot prints, muddy snow and town haze behind.
scenes.videoPrompt: Steady forward walk toward perimeter. Audio: boots on snow, gear movement, wind, distant guns and tired breathing. End without victory celebration. No speech, no narration.

characters.name: POV Soldier
characters.role: Fictional composite U.S. airborne infantry soldier
characters.description: Anonymous first-person soldier inspired by U.S. airborne units defending Bastogne in December 1944; historically plausible winter gear; face generally not shown.
characters.mainOutfit: M43 field uniform layers, airborne web gear, M1 helmet, winter gloves, M1 rifle

continuity.continuityRules: Keep gloves, sleeves, M1 rifle, winter mud and gear consistent. Wet snow, frost, mud, exhaustion and stiffness accumulate naturally across scenes and must not reset. Avoid clear facial depiction.

atmosphereAssets.title: Road to Bastogne
atmosphereAssets.description: Snowy Belgian roads, slush, convoy exhaust, muddy tire tracks, winter fields and distant engines with subdued battlefield noise.

atmosphereAssets.title: Bastogne Town
atmosphereAssets.description: Stone streets, military traffic, dirty snow, roof drips, exhaust haze and battle damage without graphic imagery; ordinary town sounds mix with distant war.

atmosphereAssets.title: Bastogne Perimeter Woods
atmosphereAssets.description: Snowy pine woods, frozen foxholes, fog, open fields, wet wool, branch creaks, falling snow and periods of deep winter quiet interrupted by distant battle sounds.
atmosphereAssets.lighting: foggy day, moonlit night, clearing winter sky
